title: Tilted send button pressed by a hand cursor
summary: A corner of an empty prompt card, leaned in perspective, fills a vertical frame; a hand cursor glides onto the round send button, presses it with a squash and slides away. A 2.8 s loopable micro-moment.
use_when: A short vertical loop that teases sending a prompt without showing an answer
The press moment inside a longer AI product film, before a thinking or result beat
Social stories where one tap is the whole message
A product whose primary action is a single round button

look.type_style: no type: a white arrow glyph on the button is the only mark

structure.shot: bottom-right corner of an empty prompt card, leaned in perspective, cropped by the frame; green round send button with an up arrow
structure.camera: tilt-plane, fixed: plane rotated (top edge leans away, right edge recedes), no pan or zoom measured (motion.json 0.03 %/s)
structure.motion: nothing moves; the card and its soft drop shadow hold from f0

structure.shot: a hand pointer cursor enters from the lower right edge, lands on the lower half of the send button and presses it
structure.motion: cursor path f14 -> f20 into the button, springs.ui (decelerates, no overshoot seen at 1 fr); rests f20-f30; press f31-f37: cursor scales ~1 -> 0.7 -> 1 and the button dips ~0.9 with it, springs.click 6 fr; holds on the button to f55

structure.shot: cursor slides out past the lower left of the card; the idle card holds, matching the first frame
structure.motion: cursor exits f55 -> f62 down and left, easings.inExpo 7 fr; then a still hold of 23 fr so the loop seam is invisible

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (white), surface for the input well, accent for the send button
params.content.placeholder: optional placeholder in the input well (the reference keeps it empty)
params.tilt: rotateX/Y/Z of the plane; reference leans the top away and the right edge back, card cropped to its bottom-right corner
params.cursor.kind: pointer (hand); size so the hand is ~0.6 of the button width

notes: Measured from a 1 fr strip of the local source: cursor visible f14-f62, lands f20, press squash f31-f37 (cursor shrinks most at f33-f34, button dips with it), leaves f55-f62, empty hold f62-f85. No ripple ring and no button colour change on the press. Single shot, no cuts, silent. Last frame equals the first, so it loops. The catalogue hint prompt-typing is not visible: the input well stays empty. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured.
